notes.title: LAUNCHING ON THE 16TH OCTOBER 2025 – REACH IS AVAILABLE TO WISHLIST NOW!
notes.notes: [p]As announced at today’s Future Game Show, [i]Reach[/i], the debut ground-breaking action-adventure from nDreams’ Elevation Studio, will be launching on the 16th October on Steam for PC VR![/p][p][/p][p]Amongst all of this, we also debuted an exclusive gameplay trailer that showcased the variety of ways that the tools can be used to aid traversal, puzzle-solving, and combat as well as a sneak peek into one of the game’s characters. If you haven’t already, check out the trailer below:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="sLeHRgLxhwU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Wish list Reach on Steam now, launching on the 16th October 2025.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3273480/Reach/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: nDreams Elevation unveils its debut title, Reach.
notes.notes: [p][i]Reach[/i] sees players embody a reluctant hero thrown into a perilous journey to uncover the secrets of an underground civilisation. Featuring true-to-life full-body awareness and presence, tactile interactions powered by advanced physics and intuitive, gesture-driven traversal, Reach aims to set new standards in VR immersion. Players must fight past mythical threats, master versatile tools, and forge a path through a dynamic world where every action directly impacts the adventure.[/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][b]Key Features:[/b] [/p][p][b]Unrivalled immersion[/b] [/p][p]Full-body awareness and true-to-life interactions deliver unmatched presence in every moment. [/p][p][b]Live the adventure[/b] [/p][p]Delve deep into a spectacular world packed with mythical threats, and secrets to uncover. [/p][p][b]Own the action[/b] [/p][p]Freely jump, climb, and zip-line across breathtaking environments with smooth, intuitive traversal designed for VR. [/p][p][b]Fight with fluidity[/b] [/p][p]Engage in thrilling and emergent combat encounters against imposing, deadly adversaries. [/p][p]Available to wishlist now.[/p]
